channel.title: Oasis Sovereign Research — Protein Folding & Proteostasis Series
channel.description: Open-access, formally verified computational biophysics and informational thermodynamics working papers (CC-BY-SA-4.0 / AGPL-3.0).

item.title: Paper 37: Multi-State Molten-Globule Kinetics and Macromolecular Crowding Optima in Cellular Protein Folding
item.description: Extensión a proteínas multi-estado (1BNI, 1HEL, 1MBN) con intermediario molten globule y óptimo fisiológico de hacinamiento celular phi=0.20. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-sa-4.0.

item.title: Paper 36: Integrated OVRP Compendium on Informational Folding, Two-State PDB Kinetics, and ATP-Driven Proteostasis (Papers 32–35)
item.description: Síntesis unificada de la serie con especificaciones en Lean 4 (0 sorry), sondas C99 y sellado Bitcoin OpenTimestamps. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-sa-4.0.

item.title: Paper 35: ATP-Driven Iterative Annealing and Kinetic Trap Rescue in High-Contact-Order Protein Folding
item.description: Presupuesto discreto de hidrólisis de ATP fuera del equilibrio para rescatar proteínas de alto orden de contacto (1APS) atrapadas en mínimos cinéticos locales. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-sa-4.0.

item.title: Paper 34: Empirical Calibration of Informational Folding Rates Against Two-State PDB Kinetics (r = -0.9437)
item.description: Calibración empírica frente a 8 proteínas experimentales del Protein Data Bank (1VII a 1APS), logrando una correlación de Pearson r = -0.9437. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-sa-4.0.

item.title: Paper 33: Non-Markovian Informational Folding, Proteostatic Stress Plateaus, and Chaperone Damping
item.description: Trayectorias discretas con núcleo de memoria no markoviano, mesetas residuales bajo estrés proteotóxico y amortiguamiento inspirado en chaperonas Hsp90. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-sa-4.0.

item.title: Paper 32 / Record 101: Monotonic Informational Folding Toward a ln(10) Ceiling
item.description: Modelo discreto de relajación monotónica inspirado en el efecto Mpemba cuántico y clásico bajo una cota superior informacional ln(10). — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-4.0.

item.title: Precursor Study: The Dimensionless Informational Ratio as a Phenotypic Attractor in Protein Folding Dynamics
item.description: Formulación inicial del atractor adimensional en paisajes de plegamiento proteico verificada en Lean 4 y C99. — Verified under OVRP (Lean 4 + C99 + Bitcoin OTS), License: cc-by-nc-4.0.
